questions.question: Change 8 750 m into kilometres, as a decimal and as a mixed number.
questions.expected_answer: Divide by 1 000, because 1 000 m make 1 km. 8 000 m is 8 km, and 750 m is three quarters of a kilometre. So 8 750 m is 8,75 km, or 8 and 3/4 km.

questions.question: Lindiwe rides 12,5 km on Monday and 8 750 m on Tuesday. How far is that altogether in kilometres?
questions.expected_answer: Change to the same unit first: 8 750 m is 8,75 km. Then 12,5 km plus 8,75 km is 21,25 km.

questions.question: How many pieces of 25 cm can be cut from a 5 m rope?
questions.expected_answer: Change 5 m into 500 cm. Then 500 divided by 25 is 20, so there are 20 pieces.
